note: CURATED BY HAND. Nothing in this file comes from a public source and the pipeline never overwrites it — the daily refresh only reads it. No open dataset maps a partner to a portfolio company, so this is where your own knowledge goes. On the site these values are shown in a visually separate column marked 'curated' so they can never be mistaken for sourced data.

howToUse.byFund: A default contact for every company held by that fund.
howToUse.byCompany: Overrides the fund default for one company. The key is the company name upper-cased with punctuation stripped, exactly as it appears as a key in data/siren-map.json — e.g. BACK MARKET.
